title: Maximum Product of Three Numbers
summary: Given an integer array, identify three numbers with the highest product and return this product.
statement: Given an integer array, identify three numbers with the highest product and return this product.
constraints: Return the maximum product of any three values at distinct indices.
hints: A maximum product uses either three large positives or two very negative values and one large positive.
Sort once and compare those two candidate products.
Return max(last three product, first two times last).
Any negative pair is maximized in magnitude by the two smallest values; otherwise the three largest values dominate.
editorial: Any negative pair is maximized in magnitude by the two smallest values; otherwise the three largest values dominate.

tests.explanation: The only triple has product six.
Two negative tens and positive five produce 500.
